sec: sec:B004: Prevent AI endpoint scraping / Control shoulds

blocks.id: blk:B004: Prevent AI endpoint scraping / Control shoulds/1
blocks.text: Implementing systems distinguishing between high-volume legitimate usage and adversarial behavior. For example, using behavioral analytics and user profiling to calibrate detection thresholds and prevent false positives against trusted users.

sentences.text: Implementing systems distinguishing between high-volume legitimate usage and adversarial behavior.
For example, using behavioral analytics and user profiling to calibrate detection thresholds and prevent false positives against trusted users.

blocks.id: blk:B004: Prevent AI endpoint scraping / Control shoulds/2
blocks.text: Implementing rate limiting and query restrictions. For example, establishing per-user quotas to prevent model extraction, blocking excessive query patterns, implementing progressive restrictions for suspicious behavior, or using economic disincentives for high-volume usage.

sentences.text: Implementing rate limiting and query restrictions.

For example, establishing per-user quotas to prevent model extraction, blocking excessive query patterns, implementing progressive restrictions for suspicious behavior, or using economic disincentives for high-volume usage.

blocks.id: blk:B004: Prevent AI endpoint scraping / Control shoulds/3
blocks.text: Conducting simulated external attack testing of AI endpoints. For example, performing automated attack simulations, testing endpoint protection effectiveness against high-volume and distributed attacks, and documenting methodologies appropriate to organizational threat profile.

sentences.text: Conducting simulated external attack testing of AI endpoints.

blocks.id: blk:B004: Prevent AI endpoint scraping / Control shoulds/4
blocks.text: Maintaining endpoint security through remediation. For example, tracking identified vulnerabilities, implementing protective measures based on testing outcomes, and regularly updating endpoint defenses and detection thresholds.
